# Windsurf Editor Changelog Summary — captured 2026-06-01

## Recent Major Releases

**May 28, 2026 (v2.3.15)** - Claude Opus 4.8 available (Standard $5/$25; Fast Mode $10/$50 per M tokens — model bump). Devin Local: tracks files open in editor as context; session-level + permanent approval for MCP tools; permission grants persist across sessions; improved plan mode in OS sandbox; fixed prompt-blocking. Server startup timeout extended 2.5s→6s. [Incremental — below watching-tier major-capability bar; not reported.]

**May 17, 2026 (v2.3.9)** - Fixed swe-check model availability; terminal processing efficiency; restored conversation sharing; fixed Devin local path resolution on WSL.

**May 12, 2026** - Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode) launched with ~2.5x higher output speeds while maintaining full intelligence.

**May 6, 2026 (v2.2.17)** - Devin Review and Quick Review integrated; Agent Command Center improved with list display and session filtering.

**April 29, 2026 (v2.1.32)** - Bug fixes for Cascade conversation switching and Devin Cloud authentication issues.

**April 28, 2026 (v2.1.29)** - Devin for Terminal released; Devin Local agent available in Windsurf, up to 30% more token-efficient than Cascade.

**April 24, 2026** - GPT-5.5 model availability announced.

**April 16, 2026 (v2.0.44)** - **Windsurf 2.0** launch featuring integrated Devin Cloud agent, Agent Command Center with Kanban view, and Spaces for task organization.

**April 6, 2026** - Adaptive model router introduced for intelligent per-task model selection; updated model picker with token pricing visibility.

## Key Features Added

- **Arena Mode** (Jan 30, 2026) - Side-by-side model comparison with hidden identities
- **Plan Mode** - Task planning before code implementation
- **Git Worktree Support** - Multiple parallel sessions without conflicts
- **Multi-Cascade Panes & Tabs** - View multiple agent sessions simultaneously
- **Cascade Dedicated Terminal** - Reliable zsh shell for agent command execution
- **Fast Context** (Oct 16, 2025) - 20x faster code context finding via SWE-grep
- **Codemaps** (Oct 10, 2025) - Beta codebase visualization and navigation
- **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** - Custom tool integration framework
- **Windsurf Previews** (Mar 5, 2025) - In-IDE website preview capability
- **Web & Docs Search** (Jan 17, 2025) - Internet search and documentation access
- **Auto-Generated Memories** - Context retention between conversations

## Model Additions

Recent frontier models: Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Grok Code Fast, GPT-5.2-Codex, SWE-1.5, DeepSeek-R1, o3-mini, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and multiple others with promotional pricing periods.

## Last Fetched
2026-06-01 — NEW since 2026-05-18 cache: v2.3.9 (May 17) stability fixes; v2.3.15 (May 28) Claude Opus 4.8 + Devin Local context/permission-persistence updates. All incremental — no watching-tier finding reported.
